body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete:

GO:0061622 glycolytic process through glucose-1-phosphate

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32471

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here:  https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/14k8hkykyTn6GjnEfSj6Ch6G72uR66vxqf3C25z_9g5A/edit?usp=sharing

~UniProt | 9~ DONE

Thanks.
